Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Keep the product private. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved. Fleet-wide legal clearance is evidence_needed: compliance is a technical baseline only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics has permission/configuration gaps; revenue covers one day with $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not infer legal clearance, ROI, or revenue from incomplete telemetry.

Launch-readiness remains active with 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Partial evidence exists: official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because authoritative rights, field-level provenance, operator-confirmed retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, and human-counsel review remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, alert and operational data flows, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent and unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep external permission outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked; user alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; GA4 analytics = evidence_needed; operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. No go-live proposal is supported. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, public display, alert expansion, affiliate use, advertising use, or jurisdiction-specific privacy decision.

Retain existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Create no new production requests, requeues, experiments, telemetry requests, spend, monetization expansion, or external outreach. Do not close compliance, data-quality, analytics, revenue, site, or launch-readiness gates without site-specific evidence. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker for ordinary growth, but unsupported claims, rights-dependent reuse, privacy expansion, and security-sensitive exposure remain blocked or counsel_required.
